## StatusChameleon

Customize the Home Screen status bar's clock, color, and more.

- Clock format presets (24h, 12h, with/without seconds, Japanese full date) plus a custom NSDateFormatter pattern
- Status bar text/icon color, chosen with a native color picker
- All changes apply live on the Home Screen — no respring needed
- A Respring button in Settings for the rare case something needs it

This tweak only injects into SpringBoard. Since iOS 13, each app draws its own status bar in its own process, so a color/format change is live on the Home Screen but won't be visible while another app (Settings included) is in the foreground.
